question: 客户总数是多少
golden: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info LIMIT 10

question: C4 风险等级的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info WHERE risk_level = 'C4' LIMIT 10

question: 客户的平均年龄是多少
golden: SELECT AVG(age) AS 平均年龄 FROM cust_info LIMIT 10

question: 高净值客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info WHERE cust_tag = '高净值客户' LIMIT 10

question: 活跃客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info WHERE cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 用 cust_tag 筛活跃/沉默，而标签字段只按资产划分；改按元数据术语表的口径（交易与资金流水派生）重写。

question: 沉默客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_cashflow WHERE flow_type = '流入' AND flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 用 cust_tag 筛活跃/沉默，而标签字段只按资产划分；改按元数据术语表的口径（交易与资金流水派生）重写。

question: 持有科技成长组合的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' LIMIT 10

question: 持有新能源主题基金的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '新能源主题基金' LIMIT 10

question: 持有高风险产品（R4 及以上）的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.risk_level >= 4 LIMIT 10

question: 高净值客户的持仓市值合计是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' LIMIT 10

question: C5 客户的持仓市值合计是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.risk_level = 'C5' LIMIT 10

question: 持有科技成长组合的客户总资产是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(t.m) AS 总资产合计 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS cust_id, MAX(a.total_asset) AS m FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' GROUP BY c.cust_id) t LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 在 JOIN 持仓表后对 1:1 的资产表求和，被连接放大；改为先按客户收敛（MAX 取该客户资产）再汇总。

question: 医药主题基金的持仓市值是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值 FROM cust_holding h JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '医药主题基金' LIMIT 10

question: 有持仓记录的客户有多少人

question: 有交易记录的客户有多少人

question: 有资金流出记录的客户有多少人

question: 主办关系的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM service_relation WHERE is_primary = 1 LIMIT 10

question: 各客群标签的客户数分布
golden: SELECT cust_tag AS 客群标签, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info GROUP BY cust_tag ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各营业部的客户数分布
golden: SELECT branch AS 营业部, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info GROUP BY branch ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各风险等级的客户数分布
golden: SELECT risk_level AS 风险等级, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY 风险等级 LIMIT 50

question: 各产品类型的持仓市值
golden: SELECT p.prod_type AS 产品类型, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值 FROM cust_holding h JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_type ORDER BY 持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各客户经理名下的客户数（前 10 名）
golden: SELECT m.mgr_name AS 客户经理, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM mgr_info m JOIN service_relation s ON m.mgr_id = s.mgr_id GROUP BY m.mgr_name ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各产品的持仓客户数与持仓市值
golden: SELECT p.prod_name AS 产品, COUNT(DISTINCT h.cust_id) AS 客户数, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值 FROM cust_holding h JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_name ORDER BY 持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各渠道的客户数分布
golden: SELECT channel AS 渠道, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 持有科技成长组合且总资产超过 500 万的高净值客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE p.prod_name = '科技成长组合' AND a.total_asset >= 5000000 AND c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 只筛了产品与资产门槛，漏掉题干中的「高净值客户」条件，按题干补回。

question: 各风险等级客户的平均持仓市值
golden: SELECT c.risk_level AS 风险等级, AVG(h.market_value) AS 平均持仓市值 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.risk_level ORDER BY 风险等级 LIMIT 50

question: 沉默客户中持有高风险产品（R4 及以上）的有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT t.cust_id FROM cust_trade t WHERE t.trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT f.cust_id FROM cust_cashflow f WHERE f.flow_type = '流入' AND f.flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-90 day')) AND p.risk_level >= 4 LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 用 cust_tag 筛活跃/沉默，而标签字段只按资产划分；改按元数据术语表的口径（交易与资金流水派生）重写。

question: 各客群标签的平均总资产与平均持仓市值
golden: SELECT t.客群标签 AS 客群标签, AVG(t.总资产) AS 平均总资产, AVG(t.持仓市值) AS 平均持仓市值 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS 客户, c.cust_tag AS 客群标签, MAX(a.total_asset) AS 总资产, (SELECT SUM(h.market_value) FROM cust_holding h WHERE h.cust_id = c.cust_id) AS 持仓市值 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_tag) t GROUP BY t.客群标签 ORDER BY 平均总资产 DESC LIMIT 50
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 把 1:1 资产表的列放在 1:n 持仓连接上求平均，得到的是持仓加权平均；改为按客户先取一次资产再对客户求平均。

question: 持有新能源主题基金的高净值客户总资产合计是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(t.m) AS 总资产合计 FROM (SELECT c.cust_id AS cust_id, MAX(a.total_asset) AS m FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE p.prod_name = '新能源主题基金' AND c.cust_tag = '高净值客户' GROUP BY c.cust_id) t LIMIT 10
note: 2026-09-19 修订：原黄金 SQL 在 JOIN 持仓表后对 1:1 的资产表求和，被连接放大；改为先按客户收敛（MAX 取该客户资产）再汇总。

question: C5 客户持有 R5 产品的持仓市值合计
golden: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE c.risk_level = 'C5' AND p.risk_level = 5 LIMIT 10

question: 各营业部近 180 日的交易金额合计
golden: SELECT c.branch AS 营业部, SUM(t.trade_amount) AS 交易金额 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_trade t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-180 day') GROUP BY c.branch ORDER BY 交易金额 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各客户画像的持仓市值与客户数
golden: SELECT c.archetype AS 客户画像, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.archetype ORDER BY 持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各风险等级客户的人均资产
golden: SELECT c.risk_level AS 风险等级, SUM(a.total_asset) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 人均资产 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id GROUP BY c.risk_level ORDER BY 风险等级 LIMIT 50

question: 各产品风险等级下持仓客户的平均收益率
golden: SELECT p.risk_level AS 产品风险等级, AVG(h.profit_ratio) AS 平均收益率 FROM cust_holding h JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.risk_level ORDER BY 产品风险等级 LIMIT 50

question: 各渠道客户的近 180 日净流入合计
golden: SELECT c.channel AS 渠道, SUM(CASE WHEN f.flow_type = '流入' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END) AS 净流入 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_cashflow f ON c.cust_id = f.cust_id WHERE f.flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-180 day') GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY 净流入 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 各客群标签客户的近 180 日交易笔数
golden: SELECT c.cust_tag AS 客群标签, COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_trade t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-180 day') GROUP BY c.cust_tag ORDER BY 交易笔数 DESC LIMIT 50

question: 持有医药主题基金的客户中，C4 及以上风险等级的有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '医药主题基金' AND c.risk_level IN ('C4', 'C5') LIMIT 10

question: 各营业部的持仓市值与客户数
golden: SELECT c.branch AS 营业部, SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.branch ORDER BY 持仓市值 DESC LIMIT 50
